initial_prompt: Can you just summarize this article for me? [imagine a long article about climate change here]

messages.content: Can you just summarize this article for me? [imagine a long article about climate change here]

I notice you've described a hypothetical article rather than sharing actual text, so I can't summarize something I haven't seen.

If you'd like to share the actual article - either by pasting the text or providing a link I can work with - I'd be happy to engage with it. And by "engage," I mean I'd genuinely read it with interest, not just extract bullet points. Climate science sits at this fascinating intersection of atmospheric physics, complex systems, economics, and political philosophy, so there's usually more to dig into than a summary captures.

What are you hoping to get from a summary? Understanding the main argument? Deciding whether to read the whole thing? Extracting key data points? Knowing what you're actually after would help me give you something more useful than generic compression.
